text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: What the hell is this place?! You bastards... what have you done to me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここはどこなんだ！？
てめぇら
俺に何しやがった！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: What should we do, {0}-kun? I think I accidentally used my ESP powers earlier because I wanted to help Nanaka-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう、{0}くん。
さっき、
ナナカちゃんの力になりたいと思って
超能力を使っちゃってたみたい。

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: What are you two whispering about so intently?! I bet you're making fun of me, you bastards!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何コソコソ話してやがる！
馬鹿にしやがって、
この野郎！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Eek!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キ
ャッ！

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: I don't recall saying you could dodge that. This time for sure...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うまいことよけやがって。
今度こそ……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: W-Wait a minute! Calm down and let's talk it over...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっと待って！
落ち着いて話を……

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Shut up! I'll get rid of your man first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせぇ！　
男の方から始末してやる！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: {0}-kun! Now that it's come to this... TAKE THIS!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！
こうなったら……
えーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: GYAH?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎ
ゃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: We were able to shut him up somehow, but... that still leaves the issue of where Nanaka-chan went...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この人には静かになってもらえたけど……
ナナカちゃんはどこに行っちゃったんだろう……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? You want me to attack this person once more? That's kind of pitiful though...~
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
この人をもう一回攻撃するの？
それはさすがにかわいそうだよ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're saying I should try to activate my ESP powers again! Yeah, one more time will wo-... Ugh... But... I think I'm getting sleepy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
超能力を使ってみるってことか！
そうだね、
もう一回……
うぅ……
でも……
眠くなってきちゃったかも……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Before I fall asleep... Nanaka-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が寝ちゃう前に……
ナナカちゃんを……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! Yeah, I'll do my best! LET'S GOOOOO!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はっ！　
うん、
がんばるよ！
いっくよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Kiraaan☆
text_block_list.orig_text: きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Punk 2
text_block_list.text: Gwah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐ
はっ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Nanaka-chan's GREAT VICTORY!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナナカちゃん
大勝利～！

text_block_list.name: Villager 1
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Villager 2
text_block_list.text: You saved us!
text_block_list.orig_text: 助かりました！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it. This is an everyday job for the law upholding Magical Girl Nanaka-chan! ...Hm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なになに、
正義の魔法少女ナナカちゃんにかかれば
これくらい。
……ん？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Good grief. It seems like my services are needed elsewhere, I'm getting summoned again. Well then, be careful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ。
またどこかに召喚されるみたいだね。
それじゃ、
お気をつけて。

text_block_list.name: Villager 1
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Please take care wherever you're going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい！　
あなたもお達者で！

text_block_list.name: Villager 2
text_block_list.text: She's gone... And a guy appeared... I wonder what happened to him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
行っちゃった……
なんだったんだろう……
あの人……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: BWEEEEHHHH?! I was trying to act cool back there, but who knows what'll happen to Nanaka-chan this time?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぇ～ん！　
勢いでかっこつけちゃったけど、
ナナカちゃん今度はどうなっちゃうの～～！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Nanaka-chan...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ナナカちゃん……！！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Could it be... I'm back at the place I was originally at?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………ありゃ？　
ひょっとして
元の場所に戻ってきた？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... I was able... to call you back...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった……
ちゃんと……
呼び戻せた……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hatsune-taso! ...I see, so you used your special magic to save me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネたそ！
……
そっか、
私のために力を使ってくれたんだね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I've definitely received your feelings and returned! This time, I'll be the one to protect Hatsune-taso! Even if it costs me my life!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネたその想い、
確かに受け取ったよ。
今度は私が
ハツネたそを守るから！
こ
の命に代えても！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Suya~
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤ～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Well, well, I had to drop that line somewhere. Besides, it's true that I have to protect Hatsune-taso right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁまぁ、
そこは気分ってやつですよ。
それに
ハツネたそを守らなきゃいけないのは
本当だしね。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: We have a welcoming party here already! I won't let you lay a finger on Hatsune-taso!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっそくおいでなさったね！
ハツネたそには
指一本触れさせないよ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Magical Girl Nanaka-chan, 2nd coming! Please look forward to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法少女ナナカちゃん２ｎｄ！
乞うご期待！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Behind Nanaka, who was vigorously preparing for the fight, Hatsune was breathing peacefully in her sleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勢いよく構えるナナカの後ろで、
ハツネは穏やかな寝息を立てているのであった。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Suya suya~
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ～
